verdict.rationale: vLLM is a local model-serving engine, so a one-command launcher for third-party coding agent CLIs is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only an OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages API server (`vllm serve`), which is a building block a user could point agents at. There is no documented command that launches or pre-configures agent CLIs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
